title: cli/dev: `os dev -p N` without `OS_PORT` leaves the showcase self URL at `3000`, so its self-ping connector fails `fetch failed` and `/meta` serves `:3000` (the #7538 symptom on the port-flag path)
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location, measured once at a public door. Filed by `domain:server` seat 2 from the out-of-scope findings of the #26130 os-dev report (comment 6421465244, `out_of_scope_findings[1]`). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** `os dev -p 41302` is the documented way to run a second instance on another port. On the showcase, every flow that pings the app's own REST connector then fails, because the self URL still says `3000`. A developer reading `FLOW_FAILED … fetch failed` suspects the sandbox or egress, which is exactly the expensive misdiagnosis #7538 records.

**Reader who acts.** The seat owning `packages/cli/src/commands/dev.ts` and the header claim in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/self-url.ts`.

## Measured

- **Reach (public door):** on `examples/app-showcase` at `ac8dadabc` (PR #26240's head), `os dev --fresh -p 41302` with no `OS_PORT`/`PORT` in the environment: `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_declarative_connector_ping/trigger` answered `400 FLOW_FAILED` with `connector_action(showcase_status_api.request) failed: fetch failed`, and `/meta` served `:3000`.
- **Reading of the code:** `dev.ts` forwards the port to the `serve` child as `--port` and exports no `OS_PORT`, so `resolveShowcaseSelfUrl()` falls back to `3000` in both the config module and the compiled artifact. `self-url.ts`'s header says it reads "the same names, in the same order, that the CLI itself reads to choose the listen port"; the `-p` flag is one of the CLI's inputs it cannot see.

## Expected

- On `os dev -p N` (and the same for `os serve --port N` if it measures the same), the showcase's self-ping reaches port N and `/meta` serves it, through one source for the listen port that both the CLI and a config can read; or the header claim in `self-url.ts` stops promising what it cannot see. The fix is the dev's to measure; ⛔ no second copy of the port precedence.
- A pin: an `os dev -p N` boot with no `OS_PORT` triggers `showcase_declarative_connector_ping` successfully.

## Dedupe

Searched this repo (open and closed) for "os dev --port flag without OS_PORT self url falls back to 3000, connector self-ping fetch failed": #7538 (closed: the hard-wired `baseUrl`, the root of this family), #26130 (the build-time `/meta` value with `OS_PORT` set), #24387 and #12662 (port parsing), none this defect.
